learning_outcomes.text: Assess the energetic, economic, and environmental implications of consuming alternative fuels to petroleum derivatives in automotive.

Understand current and future lines of promotion in Europe and Spain aimed at energy saving in automotive, and the most advanced current technologies in improving the energy efficiency of freight and passenger transport.
Analyze practical cases and evaluate the improvements achieved with different technological solutions.
Evaluate the current energy landscape in the transport sector: fuels used, reserves, and system sustainability.

syllabus_topics: Current energy landscape of freight and passenger transport: fuels used, reserves, and system sustainability
Real alternatives to the Reciprocating Engine in automotive. Current situation and future perspectives: hybrid vehicles, electric (battery and fuel cell), etc.
Biofuels for Compression Ignition Engines (MEC): Biodiesel
Biofuels for Spark Ignition Engines (MEP): Alcohols and derivatives.
Alternative fuels for Spark Ignition Engines (MEP): LPG and NG
Hydrogen as fuel for Spark Ignition Engines (MEP) and for fuel cells. Use of batteries
Compare emissions and consumption of conventional and alternative fuels in MEP and MEC, if gas analyzer is available and Visualization of MACI in the laboratory and videos on the subject
Reports of the practices, if applicable
Completion of an individual work and its presentation if applicable
assessment_rules: For students with continuous assessment, if grades in the written exam (EX) and assignment presentation (ET) are 4.0 or higher, the final grade is calculated as (0.25 x PA) + (0.50 x ET) + (0.25 x EX). Otherwise, the maximum course grade is 4.9. For students with differentiated assessment, the final grade is solely based on the written exam (EX). For all cases, a minimum course grade of 5.0 is required to pass. In extraordinary calls, for continuous assessment students, the grade is (0.50 x ET) + (0.5 x EX), or EX if ET was not participated in. For differentiated assessment students, the grade is EX.
